basis: responsibility clusters derived from source flow and import topology; not asserted upstream bounded contexts

candidates.name: composition-routing
candidates.responsibility: bootstrap runtime, select commands/tools/surfaces, and assemble the interactive or headless application

candidates.name: turn-engine
candidates.responsibility: own a user turn, model iteration, continuation state, tool-result reinjection, limits, and terminal result projection

candidates.name: effect-runtime
candidates.responsibility: interpret tool proposals through schema, hooks, permission decisions, concurrency policy, execution, and result normalization

candidates.name: built-in-effects-and-presenters
candidates.responsibility: implement built-in tools and their UI or terminal presentation contracts

candidates.name: session-recovery
candidates.responsibility: persist append-only transcripts, reconstruct parent-linked conversation state, compact context, and repair resume topology

candidates.name: extension-runtime
candidates.responsibility: discover and host plugins, skills, MCP capabilities, and hook extensions

candidates.name: surface-adapters
candidates.responsibility: adapt CLI, bridge, remote, SDK, and server transports to core turn and effect semantics

candidates.name: platform-adapters
candidates.responsibility: provide filesystem, process, configuration, telemetry, permission, OS, and provider integration mechanisms

forbiddenInterpretations: Do not treat these candidates as current package boundaries.
Do not infer safe extraction order from directory names alone.
Do not treat a cycle as proof that every participating edge is harmful.
recommendedSequence: characterize observable behavior and round-trip invariants
introduce leaf contracts and compatibility facades
separate pure codecs and policies from filesystem, provider, and UI adapters
invert one concrete dependency at a time
move one vertical extension or surface at a time
retire barrels and shims only after differential validation
